entries.existing_dose_context: 2–6 mg/kg before exercise in studies
entries.rule: For supported exercise goals only, 2–6 mg/kg studied range; do not automatically choose a point or exceed population-specific safety thresholds; account for all caffeine sources and contraindications.

additional_verified_dose_context.rule: Studied 2–6 mg/kg 15–60 min before exercise; account for all daily caffeine sources; 400 mg/day is general FDA healthy-adult reference, not universally safe threshold.
cautions: Do not exceed 400 mg/day by automatically applying weight-based study range.
Pregnancy, arrhythmias, sleep disturbance and stimulant medications require separate exclusions.
